name: Ishidou Narumi
source:
The story's protagonist. 
A young man who has become exceedingly caring, mainly thanks to Mitama. 

Perhaps because of being around irresponsible people growing up, he has become a stable man. He is therefore a man of action, and often finds himself at the center of things. Despite being a bit of a hassle, he is fundamentally a good person who will always work for the good of others.

[translated and modified from [url=http://www.astronauts.co.jp/comet/koreuba/c04.html]official website[/url]]
